Lisbon, since 1974

We make chairs, tables and cabinets by hand, in oak, walnut and Portuguese cork.

The studio

Aurelia Atelier was founded in 1974 by Ines Aurelia in a converted bakery in Alcantara. The workshop has occupied the same three rooms ever since.

Eleven people work here. Six are cabinetmakers, two are finishers, and three keep everything else moving.

Every piece is made to order. A dining table takes nine weeks; a cabinet with hand-cut dovetails takes fourteen.

We do not use veneer over particle board, and we do not stain wood to imitate a species it is not.

Materials
  • European oak, quarter-sawn, air-dried for four years
  • American black walnut
  • Portuguese cork, from Alentejo
  • Hard wax oil finish, no polyurethane
